blocks.text: Managing payroll administrative tasks on Mac

Payroll processing software help often focuses on the math. The real challenge is the coordination. You are constantly moving data between platforms like Gusto, Rippling, or ADP and your local Excel files. This creates a fragmented workflow. You might have a time-tracking system in one tab, an HRIS in another, and a spreadsheet for reconciliation. Keeping these aligned requires manual effort.

Email is the hidden cost. You receive over 100 emails a day, but only a small portion requires immediate action. Every time you switch from Excel to Outlook to answer a query, you lose focus. It takes over 20 minutes to get back into the flow of complex reconciliation. Lazur lives in the notch of your Mac and helps you stay focused by answering questions without forcing you to click away from your main work window.

Data reconciliation is the most critical part of your day. You must verify that time-tracking data matches the payroll run. You often use Excel or Google Sheets for this. You might be comparing two columns to find discrepancies. Use the [compare two columns in Excel](/how-to/compare-two-columns-in-excel) guide to speed up this process. If you find text that should be a number, use the [convert text to numbers in Excel](/how-to/convert-text-to-numbers-in-excel) steps to fix it quickly.

The coordination tax is the time spent on things that do not show up in your official time tracking. This includes chasing signed forms, fixing file naming errors, or searching for documents in SharePoint. Documentation is vital for compliance. You need to keep records for 3 to 7 years. Lazur can help you manage these tasks by keeping your focus on the screen.

When you have a question about how to perform a task in your payroll software, hold ⌥ ⌘. Ask Lazur where a specific setting is located. Lazur will draw a circle on your screen to point it out. If you need to write a quick email to an employee about a payroll discrepancy, use the dictation feature. Hold fn and speak your message. It types clean, formatted text directly into Outlook or your email client.

blocks.text: Most modern payroll platforms are cloud-based. They run well in Chrome, Safari, or Brave on your Mac. You do not need specialized desktop software for most of these tasks. If you use QuickBooks Online, Gusto, or ADP, you are already using a browser-based tool. This means you can use Lazur to help you navigate these sites. If you are ever stuck, ask Lazur to explain the next step in your payroll workflow.

One common mistake is manual data entry. Every time you type a number from a PDF into Excel, you risk a typo. Use OCR tools where possible, but always double-check the results. Another mistake is ignoring the audit trail. Always save your reconciliation notes alongside the payroll file. If you use Excel, learn to use named ranges to make your formulas clearer. See the guide on [how to create a named range in Excel](/how-to/create-a-named-range-in-excel) for more details.

faq.question: Does Lazur click buttons in my payroll software?
faq.answer: No. Lazur does not click buttons, edit files, or operate other apps for you. It points at things on your screen and guides you through steps so you can do the work yourself.

faq.question: Is my payroll data safe when using Lazur?
faq.answer: Lazur only listens and looks at your screen while you hold the shortcut keys. Audio and screenshots are sent to AI providers to answer your request and are not stored. Your content is never used to train AI models.

faq.question: Can Lazur help me with Excel formulas?
faq.answer: Yes. You can ask Lazur how to use a specific formula or how to troubleshoot a reconciliation issue. Lazur will explain the steps you need to take.
